names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 aprilie, «Sfântul Ierarh Celestin, episcopul Romei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Κελεστίνος Πάπας Ρώμης», with the rank word and the see left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 8 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Св. Келестин папа Римски.“, with Св. left off — it is not a rank — and with папа Римски left off as well: the see is what this corpus keeps in `office`, where this folder already has «Bishop of Rome». The heading leaves no epithet, so the bare forename is what the source gives.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 8 апреля ст. ст., name page 1192, «Святитель Келестин I Римский, папа», with the rank word and the office word left off and **the ordinal kept, which no other book read for this folder gives him**. The day’s own line gives the forename and the see declined, «Келестина, папы Римского». The life opens with a second spelling in brackets, «Келестин (Целестин)», which is not stored as a separate form because it is a variant of the same word in the same sentence of the same page. No folder holds this form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 апреля ст. ст. — «Свт. Келестина, папы Римского (432).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 aprilie — «Sfântul Ierarh Celestin, episcopul Romei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Κελεστίνος Πάπας Ρώμης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 432)». The day of his death it gives is not 8 April but «την 26η ή 27η Ιουλίου, κατά την πιο πιθανή γνώμη», 26 or 27 July by the most probable opinion — a reading recorded here, not a second feast. It gives his father's name as Priscus and his accession as 422, after the death of Pope Boniface. The page prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.04.2026 (8. април ст. ст.) — „Св. Келестин папа Римски.“

attestations.note: The day's third entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek both keep him on. The man is the same beyond doubt: the pope of Rome who acted against Nestorius at the time of the Third Ecumenical Council and reposed in 432 — and the 432 agrees exactly with what this folder holds off saint.gr, so **no date was touched**. New to the folder, in three sentences: that he was **a great zealot of the Orthodox faith**, and that **he wrote an epistle against the heretic Nestorius** at the time of the Third Ecumenical Council. **The epistle is the Prologue's own and does not contradict the Greek page**, which has the pope condemn the error of Nestorius at that council through a delegation of his and says nothing of a letter; both stand. The Prologue gives no see beyond Rome, which this folder keeps in `office`, no birthplace and no father, where saint.gr names Priscus. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion, and this folder has no hymn from any source.

death.note: saint.gr: «Πέθανε, όταν αυτοκράτορας ήταν ο Θεοδόσιος ο Β' το 432 μ.Χ. την 26η ή 27η Ιουλίου, κατά την πιο πιθανή γνώμη», and the page's heading has «Οσιος Κελεστινος Παπας Ρωμης (; - 432)». The page gives no birth year.
